Name: Crop Harvest Bubbles Revamped
Author: TheOneHermes
Description:
[b][size=5]Crop Harvest Bubbles Revamped[/size][/b]

Transform your farming experience with [b]Crop Harvest Bubbles Revamped[/b]! Originally [b]Crop Harvest Bubbles[/b] created by [b]aedenthorn[/b], this version brings vibrant and dynamic visual effects to your crops, making each harvest a delightful spectacle. Perfect for adding that extra charm to your farm!

[b][size=4]Main Features[/size][/b] [list] [][b]Dynamic Bubbles[/b] - Enjoy customizable bubbles with options for size and opacity. [][b]Seasonal Colors[/b] - Enable seasonal colors that change with the seasons for an immersive experience. [][b]Configurable Options[/b] - Use the Generic Mod Config Menu to tailor the visual effects to your liking. [][b]Performance Optimized[/b] - Smooth and efficient, designed to minimize impact on game performance. [][b]Error Handling & Logging[/b] - Robust error handling and detailed logging for smooth operation. [][b]Multilingual Support[/b] - Translations available in multiple languages, including French, Spanish, German, and more! [/list]

Changelog

version 1.1.0

Added Config Option to turn bubbles static instead of bounce

[b][size=4]Installation Instructions[/size][/b]

[b]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/b].

Download and unzip the mod into your [i]Mods[/i] folder.

Launch the game, and the mod will be loaded automatically.

Customize your settings via the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] if installed, or edit the config.jsonfile directly.

[b][size=4]Credits[/size][/b] [i]Original mod created by [b]aedenthorn[/b]. This enhanced version builds upon their fantastic work, adding more features and improvements for an even better farming experience.[/i]

[b][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/b]

Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 and later.

Works in single-player and multiplayer modes.

Should be compatible with most other mods.

[b][size=4]Support[/size][/b] If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, please feel free to leave a comment or reach out via the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/]Nexus Mods[/url] page.

Enjoy the enhanced visuals and happy farming!
